rows.grounds: gloss 'by-all' + form sarvageṇa indicates instrumental singular
gloss 'then' + form tataḥ is indeclinable adverb
gloss 'all' + form sarvaḥ indicates nominative singular masculine
gloss 'omniscience' + form sarvajñatvaṃ indicates neuter nominative singular
gloss 'not' + form na is indeclinable negation
gloss 'what' + form kiṃ indicates neuter nominative singular interrogative
gloss 'would-attain' + form bhajet indicates optative third singular active
gloss 'and-who' + form yaśca compounds relative pronoun yaḥ with ca
gloss 'from-darkness-light-covering-by-opposers' indicates compound of dhvānta, prakāśa, āvṛti, and tatpratighātin
